children: on Thursday that it has signed a deal with Anthropic
over multiple years to provide cloud infrastructure and software to support CPU workload growth at scale.
Shares of Akamai surged more than 26% in extended hours after the deal announcement.

Akamai said the deal is worth $11.6B over seven years and could be worth as much as $20B if certain conditions are met. As part of the deal, Akamai gave warrants to Anthropic that represent 7.7M shares of its Series B preferred stock that convert to roughly 5% of Akamai's common stock outstanding, at an exercise price of $111.33 per share of common stock. Part of the warrant representing 2% of Akamai's shares is expected to vest in connection with the agreement, Akamai added.

The remaining 3% will vest if the deal expands to an additional $9B over the seven-year term, with each additional $3B purchase of cloud services coming at mutually agreed upon terms, Anthropic explained.

“Anthropic is advancing the AI revolution and we are thrilled they chose Akamai’s capabilities for building and operating AI infrastructure at scale,” said Akamai co-founder and CEO Dr. Tom Leighton in a statement. “Akamai has an unparalleled reputation for helping our customers achieve their business-critical goals and build the future. Our expanding global footprint, combined with our years of experience serving the world’s largest enterprises, positions us to be the infrastructure provider for secure and responsible AI applications and workloads.”
The company will host a conference call today at 5:30 p.m. EST to discuss the deal.

title: Akamai surges after announcing massive deal with Anthropic
